name: Prince of Stride
original_name: プリンス・オブ・ストライド
source:
Stride is an extreme sport in which teams made up of six people run through town.

"You", or Sakurai Nana (default name changeable) became drawn to Stride after watching a web video depicting a Stride match with Hounan Senior High Academy. Wholeheartedly wanting to play Stride, Nana enrolled into Hounan Academy.

What awaited Nana were other boys who were to Stride the same way she was.
As you grow as a "Relationer", the leader of the team, win the "End of Summer" Eastern Japan Tournament alongside your team mates! School life, your club family, close friendship, rivalry, matches... What awaits at the end of this all?

A story about experiencing your once-in-a-lifetime youth at full speed. Youth x Sports Club. That is "Prince of Stride".

[Translation of official website story summary.]
translation:
疾走是一项极限运动，由六人组成的队伍在城镇中奔跑。

“你”，也就是樱井奈奈（默认名字可更改），在观看描绘方南学园疾走比赛的网络视频后，被疾走吸引。怀着全心全意参加疾走的愿望，奈奈进入了方南学园。

等待奈奈的是一群和她一样热爱疾走的男生。
作为队伍的Relationer（领队），与队友一同成长，赢下“夏末”东日本大赛吧！校园生活、社团成员如家人般的羁绊、深厚友情、竞争、比赛……这一切的终点等待着你的会是什么？

这是一个全速体验一生仅有一次的青春故事。青春×体育社团。这就是《疾走王子》。

[官方网站剧情简介译文。]
